# The ftp extension on PHP 8.2 to 8.4

## Upgrade instructions

Check the proposed release, then upgrade the stack:

```sh
kvsctl check
kvsctl upgrade
```

This release needs no `kvsctl` newer than 26.10.4 and introduces no database
migration. Stacks on PHP 8.1 were not affected; upgrading them only brings the
refreshed images.

After the upgrade, restart the conversion tasks that failed with error code 4
from Background tasks in the KVS admin panel: KVS does not retry them once its
automatic restarts are used up.

## Conversions on PHP 8.2, 8.3 and 8.4

The official PHP images build the ftp extension in up to PHP 8.1 and no longer
from 8.2, and the PHP-FPM and cron images of 26.10.3 and 26.10.4 did not add it
back. Without `ftp_connect()`, the KVS conversion engine refuses every task of
a conversion server set to copy the files to the storage servers itself, local
storage included, with "FTP functions not supported, this conversion server
does not support option to push files to storage servers" (error code 4). FTP
storage and conversion servers need the extension too. Since 26.10.4 selects
PHP 8.3 for KVS 7.0.3, new installations of that release were affected, as
well as stacks moved to a newer PHP series.

Both images now build the extension, with FTP over SSL, whenever their base
lacks it, and their build stops when `ftp_ssl_connect()` is missing. The image
checks assert it for every series.
([e67b0f5](https://github.com/MaximeMichaud/KVS-install/commit/e67b0f5))

A stack that cannot upgrade yet can add the extension to its running cron
container, which keeps it until the container is recreated:

```sh
cd /opt/kvs/docker && docker compose exec -T -u root cron sh -c 'docker-php-ext-configure ftp --with-openssl-dir=/usr && docker-php-ext-install ftp' </dev/null
```

On PHP 8.4, use `--with-ftp-ssl` in place of `--with-openssl-dir=/usr`.

## Release images

Every image is rebuilt on refreshed upstream bases: PHP 8.2, 8.3 and 8.4 (FPM
and CLI), NGINX mainline and Debian trixie. The PHP 8.1 source backport shipped
in 26.10.3 remains included. PHP 8.1 remains end of life.

[Full comparison with 26.10.4](https://github.com/MaximeMichaud/KVS-install/compare/26.10.4...26.10.5)
